description: This file defines functions and a class related to checking if props are serializable to JSON in a Next.js project, including validation for plain objects, arrays, and primitive types, and handling errors with a custom SerializableError class.

classes.name: SerializableError
classes.description: Custom error class for serialization errors, providing detailed messages about the serialization failure context.

methods.name: isPlainObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a plain JavaScript object.

methods.name: isSerializableProps
methods.description: Validates if the input props are serializable to JSON, throwing errors if not.
